name: Technical Tambola API
description: Express and Socket.IO game API. Frontend stays on Vercel; PostgreSQL stays on Neon.

DATABASE_URL.description: Existing Neon pooled PostgreSQL URL, including its SSL parameters.

MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL.description: Optional direct Neon URL for release migrations. Falls back to DATABASE_URL.

WEB_ORIGINS.description: Exact HTTPS Vercel frontend origin, without a trailing slash. Comma-separate multiple allowed origins.

TEST_ACCOUNTS_ENABLED.description: Temporary public testing shortcuts. Set false after real admin/player accounts are ready.

SUPER_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET.description: Optional existing Super Admin bootstrap secret; at least 32 characters.

POSTHOG_PROJECT_KEY.description: Optional phc_ project token, matching the frontend project.

POSTHOG_HOST.description: Use the ingestion region belonging to the project.

EMAIL_API_URL.description: Optional credential email API URL; configure together with EMAIL_API_KEY and EMAIL_FROM.

EMAIL_API_KEY.description: Optional email API credential; configure all three email variables together.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Optional sender email; configure all three email variables together.
